categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Bojun Industrial Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, design, production, and sales of automotive precision parts and precision molds. Its main product lines include automotive stamping parts, injection molded components, modular body assemblies, and customized molds. The company serves primarily automotive OEMs and first-tier suppliers with products such as steering system components, engine parts, door systems, sunroof systems, electronic system frames, and interior components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including stamping, laser welding, injection molding, hot forming, laser cutting, integrated die casting, and assembly. It has proprietary core technologies in stamping, welding, and insert injection molding, supported by a strong R&D team and numerous patents. The production process integrates multiple key steps to ensure precision and quality, with a focus on lightweight materials and modular automotive components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic and international automotive OEMs and first-tier suppliers such as Ideal Auto, Seres, Geely, BYD, Changan Ford, XPeng, Volkswagen, General Motors, Audi, SAIC, Dongfeng Nissan, and Tesla. The company’s products are widely used in passenger vehicles, including new energy vehicles, and it serves both domestic and export markets, with sales extending to North America, Europe, South America, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Jiangsu (Kunshan, Changzhou), Chongqing, Chengdu, Hebei, Guangdong, Shaanxi, Zhejiang, Shandong, and Ningbo. These locations correspond to major automotive industry clusters such as the Yangtze River Delta, Southwest China, Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, and Pearl River Delta clusters. The company also exports products internationally to multiple regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Bojun Industrial Technology operates in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain as a manufacturer of precision automotive parts and molds. It supplies components directly to automotive OEMs and first-tier suppliers, playing a critical role in the upstream supply of automotive assemblies and modules.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment to maintain technological leadership, focusing on lightweight materials, modular automotive components, and advanced manufacturing processes such as laser welding and integrated die casting. It actively pursues innovation in stamping, welding, injection molding, and hot forming technologies, and collaborates with academic institutions to enhance its technology platforms. The company also emphasizes automation, digitalization, and flexible manufacturing to improve efficiency and product quality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of automotive precision parts, injection molded components, and customized molds to OEMs and first-tier suppliers. The company operates on a make-to-order basis, with contracts specifying product types, quantities, and prices. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery and customer acceptance of products, with some revenue from mold sales recognized upon mold acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The automotive parts industry is fragmented with low market concentration; however, Jiangsu Bojun has established a competitive position through technological innovation, quality control, and strong customer relationships. It competes with both domestic and foreign automotive parts manufacturers, including multinational suppliers like Bosch, Magna, and Continental. The company is recognized as a leading precision parts and mold manufacturer in China with growing market share in the new energy vehicle segment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 4.23 billion, a 62.55% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 613 million, up 98.74%. Total assets reached RMB 7.05 billion, growing 42.46%, with net assets of RMB 2.49 billion, up 43.12%. The company has shown strong growth driven by expanding production capacity, increased orders, and enhanced R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Bojun emphasizes high-precision manufacturing capabilities, advanced proprietary technologies, and comprehensive quality control systems certified by IATF16949:2016. Its integrated production lines combining stamping, welding, injection molding, and assembly enable flexible, efficient manufacturing tailored to customer needs. The company’s focus on lightweight materials and modular automotive components aligns with industry trends, providing customers with innovative, cost-effective, and high-performance parts that support new energy and intelligent vehicle development.
